tools.name: search_insider_events
tools.description: Search interpreted insider-trading events from SEC Form 4 filings. Each event classifies raw filing rows into economic meaning (OPEN_MARKET_BUY vs EQUITY_AWARD vs TAX_WITHHOLDING_ONLY etc.), separating discretionary trades from compensation noise. Supports filtering by ticker, event type, minimum US

tools.name: get_company_timeline
tools.description: Get one merged, time-ordered feed of SEC insider activity for a company: Form 4 events, Schedule 13D/13G stake filings, and Form 144 sale notices, distinguished by the source_form field (form4 | sc13 | form144). The limit applies after merging, so companies with heavy Form 4 activity can crowd out 1

tools.name: get_activist_stakes
tools.description: Get Schedule 13D/13G beneficial-ownership filings (activist and 5%+ large-holder stakes) for one company - ticker is required. Returns one row per filing with filer names and the maximum reported percent of class; detailed item narrative text is not included. event_revision is always null for these

tools.name: get_sale_notices
tools.description: Get Form 144 notices of proposed insider sales for one company - ticker is required. shares_to_sell and aggregate_market_value are as-filed intentions announced before the sale, not executed trades - the matching Form 4 sale, if any, typically follows about a day later. event_revision is always null
